reproduction.method: Real paired FriendService/grant/encrypted catalog fixture, then ModelCatalog; no external API.

design.remote_sharing: Retain compatibility boolean; add sharing_basis=remote_catalog_advertisement and sharing_configuration_known=false.
design.recipient_access: Separate observed kind friend/personal_space/unknown, consumer identity and basis. Only authenticated valid receiver binding can project precise relationship/permission revisions. Never claim fresh invocation success or full provider permissions.
design.local_models: Preserve actual local sharing configuration; sharing_configuration_known=true.
design.inspect_services: Retain friend_grants array; add friend_grants_scope with provider_peer_id=self, direction=local_outgoing, remote_provider_grants=unknown. Clarify list/inspect tool descriptions.
design.verification: New static fields participate in strict receipt comparisons. Do not ignore drift or retroactively repair old receipts.
design.admission: No grant, binding, destination, dispatch, availability or access-policy changes.

validation_scope: Personal-space, unverified advertisement, invalid receiver binding and stale observations.
Empty local outgoing grants with remote received model does not prove absent provider grants.
Peer binding, catalog, read verification, observation transitions and atomic sharing regressions.
